nav.label: Settings sections
nav.title: Settings
signIn.title: Sign in to SIRes
signIn.lead: Super Intelligence Researcher is part of the eTroy platform. Your account is managed by eTroy.
signIn.note: SIRes has no password of its own. You go to the eTroy sign-in page and then come back here.
signIn.footer: SIRes · eTroy platform · built by the eTroy SWE, GEN AI, AIE and PO teams
signIn.expired: Your session has expired. What you were typing is kept and comes back after you sign in.
signIn.error.oidc_unavailable.title: eTroy is temporarily not responding
signIn.error.oidc_unavailable.body: No data was changed. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, contact your eTroy administrator.
signIn.error.login_cancelled.title: Sign-in was cancelled at eTroy
signIn.error.login_cancelled.body: No data was changed. Select “Sign in with eTroy” when you are ready.
signIn.error.login_failed.title: Sign-in failed
signIn.error.login_failed.body: No data was changed. eTroy could not confirm this sign-in; try again, and if it keeps failing, contact your eTroy administrator.
profile.title: Profile
profile.displayNameHint: Taken from eTroy the first time
profile.scholarHint: Only a link, not a Google sign-in.
profile.context: Use my research field as context for agents
profile.contextHint: When on, only “Research field” is sent to agents. Name, email, affiliation, picture and Scholar URL are never sent.
profile.noPassword: There is no password and no sign-in method other than eTroy.
profile.error.displayName.too_big: The display name can have at most 200 characters.
profile.error.affiliation.too_big: The affiliation can have at most 300 characters.
profile.error.researchField.too_big: The research field can have at most 300 characters.
profile.error.scholarUrl.invalid_format: The URL is not valid — it must start with https://. Changes were not saved.
providers.title: Provider Connections
providers.lead: You bring your own API keys; SIRes has no default key or quota. Keys are encrypted and only shown masked.
providers.empty.title: Add your API key so agents can work
providers.empty.reason: No connection yet. Agents cannot run until there is a Valid connection. Create the first one in the form below.
providers.col.name: Name
providers.noModelList: Could not get the model list
providers.retestNotSaved: the new test result; the previous one is kept.
providers.form.name: Connection name
providers.form.baseUrlHint: The official endpoint is filled in. You can change it (proxy, gateway, self-hosted) as long as it is compatible with the chosen provider’s official API.
providers.form.baseUrlError: The base URL must be a valid https:// link.
providers.form.keyHint: At least 8 characters. The key is never shown again after saving.
providers.form.keyKeep: Leave empty to keep the current key.
providers.form.keyError.too_small: The API key needs at least 8 characters.
providers.form.nameError.too_big: The connection name can have at most 100 characters.
providers.form.nameError.duplicate_name: A connection with this name exists. Choose another name.
providers.form.testingStatus: Sending a test request to the provider…
providers.form.saveHint: “Test connection” saves the connection, then tests it; “Save” turns on when the result is Valid. A connection that is not Valid stays in the table to fix later.
providers.privacy.text: What you send to agents is sent to the provider you set up. Only the context the Orchestrator assembles for each agent run is sent; of your personal details, only “Research field” is included, and only when you turn it on in Profile.
providers.privacy.needAck: “Test connection” turns on once “I have read this” is ticked.
providers.result.noModels: Could not get the model list; type the model name when you assign it to an agent.
providers.deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
providers.deleteDialog.free: No agent uses this connection. Deleting cannot be undone; the key is destroyed.
providers.deleteDialog.inUse: The connection is used by {{count}} agents: {{agents}}. Choose a Valid replacement for them. Deleting cannot be undone.
providers.deleteDialog.noValid: There is no other valid connection to switch to.
providers.deleteDialog.chooseFirst: Choose a replacement connection to delete.
providerError.auth_failed: The provider rejected the API key.
providerError.permission_denied: The key is not allowed to use this model.
providerError.model_not_found: No model was found at this base URL.
providerError.quota_exceeded: The key has used up its quota.
providerError.context_too_long: The content is longer than the model accepts.
providerError.timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
providerError.invalid_response: The response had an unexpected format; check the base URL.
error.duplicate_name: A connection with this name exists.
error.connection_in_use: An agent started using this connection; the list was reloaded. Choose a replacement and delete again.
error.model_not_available: This model is not in the connection’s model list.
agents.title: Agent Models
agents.lead: Each agent runs on one of your Provider Connections. Choose the connection first, then a model it offers.
agents.default.title: Default
agents.default.hint: Agents set to “Use the default” follow this setting.
agents.connectionNotValid: Connection {{status}}; Tasks that need this agent will be Blocked
agents.capabilityMissing: The model does not declare the {{capability}} capability this agent needs.
agents.sameModel: Analysis Agent A and B both use {{model}} on “{{name}}”.
agents.noValid.title: No valid connection yet
agents.noValid.reason: Add and test a provider connection before choosing models for agents.
agents.manualHint: The provider returned no list; type the exact model name.
agents.listedAt: List fetched from the connection at {{time}}.
agents.notListed: The model list has not been fetched.
agents.modelNotAvailable: This model is not in the connection’s list. Refresh the list or choose another model.
agents.embedding.title: Embedding model
agents.embedding.scope: One model for the whole account
agents.embedding.hint: OpenAI or Gemini only. Changing the model means re-indexing.
agents.embedding.none: No embedding model is chosen; References cannot be indexed yet.
agents.embedding.noChoice: No valid connection offers an embedding model.
agents.embedding.dialog.title: Change the embedding model?
agents.embedding.dialog.count: Every indexed Reference must be indexed again.
agents.embedding.dialog.usage: Indexing uses quota on the connection “{{name}}”.
agents.embedding.dialog.unavailable: While re-indexing, evidence retrieval from these References is unavailable.
preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.uiLanguageHint: Does not change research content, drafts or fixed terms.
preferences.agentLanguageHint: Drafts are still written in the manuscript’s language.
preferences.debug.label: Debug mode
preferences.debug.explain: When on, the full prompt and response of later Agent Runs are kept for 30 days, then deleted; only the account owner can see them. Turning it off does not delete what was already kept. Turning it on or off is recorded as an Audit Event.
preferences.thresholds.title: Verification thresholds
preferences.thresholds.lead: The Verification Agent uses these thresholds to grade claim support and flag citation mismatches. The defaults are calibrated for support accuracy ≥ 85% and mismatch detection ≥ 95%.
preferences.thresholds.invalid: Enter a number from 0 to 1, for example 0.8.
preferences.thresholds.applies: Applies from the next verification; existing results do not change.
preferences.thresholds.supported.name: Supported
preferences.thresholds.supported.desc: Lowest score for a claim to count as Supported.
preferences.thresholds.partiallySupporte: Lowest score for a claim to count as Partially Supported.
preferences.thresholds.mismatch.name: Citation mismatch
preferences.thresholds.mismatch.desc: A citation scoring below this is flagged as a mismatch.
preferences.thresholds.dialog.title: Restore default thresholds?
preferences.thresholds.dialog.body: All three thresholds go back to the system defaults. Verification runs already done do not change.
agents.sameModelWhy: Both sides of the discussion tend to make the same mistakes. Choose another model for one instance; another provider is not required. The setting is still saved, and the warning is recorded in the Deliberation Record of later sessions.
providers.result.impact: No agent can use this connection yet.
providers.result.quota: Check the key’s quota at the provider.
providers.result.compatible: The base URL must be compatible with the chosen provider’s official API.
